description: Retrieve the recent event timeline for a private monitor, including creation, stale transitions, recovery, blocked checks, and revocation. Requires its monitor ID and one-time monitor token. Event records never contain customer payloads. Example: invoke monitor_history with the required arguments shown in its input schema; use the workspace or resource credentials issued by Zorqelio, never placeholder credentials in production.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

monitorToken.description: Secret token issued for this monitor.

operationId.description: Stable unique request identifier. Reuse it only for an exact retry.

name: monitor_history
